locations.name: Dormitory
locations.description: Morning light slips through the curtains. Your room is quiet, and the academy day is about to begin.

actions.label: Read the letter on your desk
actions.feedback: A short note from the academy reminds you to attend the morning briefing.

locations.name: Academy Courtyard
locations.description: Students cross the courtyard beneath old trees. A rustling comes from the gate. Something small is moving in the bushes.

actions.label: Talk to Mira
actions.feedback: Mira smiles. “Morning! Are you heading to practical training too?”

actions.label: Read the notice board
actions.feedback: The notice board lists today's classes and the training-dungeon briefing.

actions.label: Investigate the rustling near the gate
Practice basic combat techniques
actions.feedback: You repeat the academy's basic drills until the movements begin to feel familiar.

events.title: Movement in the bushes
events.description: A goblin is rummaging through a student's dropped bag near the gate. It has not noticed you yet. What will you do?

choices.label: Sneak past the goblin
choices.feedback: You move quietly around the bushes. The goblin does not notice you.

locations.name: Practical Classroom
locations.description: Field maps cover the walls. Training equipment is arranged neatly beside the instructor's desk.

actions.label: Talk to the instructor
actions.feedback: The instructor asks you to report to the Guild Hall for your first assignment.

actions.label: Study the field maps
actions.feedback: The field maps show the academy grounds and a small supervised dungeon.

actions.label: Attend the fundamentals lesson
actions.feedback: You spend the hour studying the fundamentals of adventuring and field safety.

locations.name: Guild Hall
locations.description: A broad counter separates the students from the expedition clerks. Reports and requests are pinned behind them.

actions.label: Talk to the guild clerk
actions.feedback: The clerk explains how expedition reports are submitted.

actions.label: Browse expedition requests
actions.feedback: Most requests are reserved for senior students. One training survey is available.

locations.name: Academy Infirmary
locations.description: The infirmary is quiet and orderly. Clean beds line the walls, and a faint herbal scent lingers in the air.

actions.label: Receive treatment
actions.feedback: You rest while the infirmary staff tend to your wounds.

locations.name: Academy Canteen
locations.description: The canteen is warm and busy. Students gather here between lessons to eat and exchange news.

actions.label: Have a meal
actions.feedback: You take a quiet break over a simple meal. The pause lifts your spirits.
